message.reasoning_content: "I'm Talking About You" — Chuck Berry cover, recorded at BBC, sung by John Lennon? Actually Beatles BBC version of "I'm Talking About You" was sung by George Harrison. Yes, George sang lead on the BBC recording (from "On Air – Live at the BBC Vol 2").
